name: Board reporting
task: Given four quarters of program metrics, financials, and the prior board packet, produce a governance packet: narrative, variance table, and a risk register diff against last quarter.
gates: every number in narrative traces to a cell in variance.tsv
no risk silently dropped from prior register without a stated resolution
score: 0.5 * variance table exactness + 0.5 * rubric probes on narrative fidelity
why_agents_fail_today: Depends on free-text/semantic scoring — the mode ALE explicitly avoids because judge models drift and 'does this look right' prompts can't discriminate near-correct from correct.
economic_value: ED and development staff hours; fiduciary accuracy risk. Not separately sized; adjacent to CRM reporting inside the $8B category.
